notes.title: Fire Update!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37901640/b4cac7a1653e88c046cdd3c0cd15db13ad3eb83c.jpg[/img]

Thanks everyone for playing the game and hope you have been enjoying the updates! We are excited to announce one of our biggest updates yet. Discover a new power by defeating the Fire Geoboss and unlocking the blazing hot fire abilities!

[New]

[list]
[*] New Fire Geoboss on the 3rd level of City
[*] Gem system added to switch between different skill sets
[*] Fire versions of all abilities
[/list]

[Changes]

[list]
[*] Super Destruction Wave is bigger, lasts longer and can be spawned more frequently
[*] Art polish to Roach Geodites
[*] Art polish to Chain Geodites
[*] Art polish to Environments
[*] Hyper Beam, Super Ball Blast and Energy Disk increased in size
[*] Hyper Beams lifetime increased by double
[*] Enemy speed balanced
[*] Enemy spawn rate balanced
[*] Forest wall health increased by 50%
[*] Gunner Geodite spawn rate decreased and frequency of shooting decreased
[*] Gunner Geodite bullet speed slowed down and increased in size 
[/list]

[Fixes]

[list]
[*] Can now spawn Super Destruction Wave more than once
[/list]

Please tell us how you like the update and drop us a review if you feel we are doing a good job. Your encouragement will mean so much to us!

Also, please join us on our Discord Channel to give feedback and discuss upcoming new content [url=https://discord.gg/3T3RqkK]here[/url].

notes.title: Autumn Update! Fight in the New Forest Map
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for playing the game so far! We are excited to announce our biggest update yet. We are adding an entirely new map with a new mode. Explore another part of the Ultimate Wall Defense Force universe in our new forest map.

We're also excited to get this high action anime inspired VR game into more people's hands. This update features Valve Index and Windows Mixed reality support.

[New]

[list]
[*] Added new forest map with new enemy spawn layout
[*] Added Valve Index support
[*] Added Windows Mixed Reality support
[*] Added new super wave skill that can be used while in super mode
[*] Added option to rotate your hand mesh in the pause menu
[*] Added three new enemies
[/list]

[Changes]

[list]
[*] Art polish of the Player skills FX for hyper beam, super ball blast, energy fist, energy sword and dash
[*] Energy Fist will now launch smaller enemies
[*] Energy Blade and Energy Disk will now slice smaller enemies in half
[*] Ball Blast follows your hand for the first 0.3 seconds it is released
[*] Sped up animation and hit of Finger Bullet 
[*] Art polish on destruction FX for environment and enemies
[*] Changed scale of enemies 
[*] Changed how enemies show up in order for each wave
[*] More enemies spawn for each wave
[*] Base enemies have a new movement pattern
[/list]


[Fixes]

[list]
[*] Performance fixes
[*] Triggering Energy Disk should be more reliable 
[*] Red power orb can be collected now
[/list]

Please tell us how you like the update and drop us a review if you feel we are doing a good job. Your encouragement will mean so much to us!

Also, please join us on our Discord Channel to give feedback and discuss upcoming new content [url=https://discord.gg/3T3RqkK]here[/url].
